div.div: هَذُوذٌ (S, L, K) and هَذَّاذٌ (K) and ↓ هَذٌّ , (L, CK,) or ↓ هِذٌّ , (as in some copies of the K, and in the TA,) and ↓ هَذْهَاذٌ and هُذَاهِذٌ, (L, K [the last in the CK هَذَاهِذٌ],) Sharp; quickly cutting: (S, L, K:) the first, which is masc. and fem., and the second, applied to a knife; (S * L;) and the last two, to a (??)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
